mentions.name: Recurring Subscription Auditor
mentions.description: A free, browser-based tool that audits recurring subscriptions from a pasted bank or credit card statement. It runs entirely client-side in a single HTML file with no account sign-ups and no data transmitted to a server. It covers 6 regions, 250+ subscription services across 30+ categories, recognizing 850+ billing name patterns, with built-in smart alerts for region-specific issues (e.g., FTC's Adobe settlement, Hola VPN danger, UK price hike exit rights, Cloud Act warning). It totals monthly and annual spend and identifies savings opportunities and more ethical alternatives, with plans to add more regions.
mentions.problem: Recurring subscription charges are hard to audit and people with limited financial literacy lose track of them; the tool was born from the author's best friend's financial illiteracy.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a free lightweight solution to auditing recurring subscriptions from a pasted bank/cc statement, born from my best friends financial illiteracy.
